about: Mac App Store frames. NativeStoreScenesTests photographs each scene in the real app window, on the Lantern Night folder in distribution/app-store/scenes; scripts/store-frames/render.mjs frames each scene with the caption here. Every caption must stay true of the build it ships with (Guideline 2.3). The first three shots are the ones search results show. *Emphasis* in a headline renders in italics with its asterisks left in, faintly, the way Ouro MD shows Markdown.

creative.about: The iOS 27 product page header (no caption: the App Store sets the app's name over it) and search results art. Whether the Mac App Store shows them is not documented; the stager reports it.
